title: [Master]-Time zone issue to the G/L report in Business Central
summary: The GetUserTimezoneOffset function in the Type Helper codeunit now correctly accounts for Daylight Saving Time when calculating timezone offsets, fixing timezone display issues in G/L reports.
key_points: Fixes incorrect timezone calculations that didn't account for DST
Affects the GetUserTimezoneOffset function in codeunit 10
Resolves G/L report display issues related to timezone handling
Single-line fix to the Type Helper codeunit
quote: The Type Helper codeunit does not account for Daylight Saving Time (DST) in the GetUserTimezoneOffset function.
